newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values move higher.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values move higher.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values moved higher in reaction to shipping delays on the Illinois River and to the temporary shutdown of the damaged Zen-noh loading terminal at the U.S. Gulf, grain dealers said.
High water on the Illinois River prompted speed restrictions on tows, slowing the movement of product to the Gulf, dealers said.
Although steady Wednesday, corn basis values rose early this week because of shipping slowdowns and demand to fill sales to Spain, dealers said.
Winter wheat values were unchanged.
